One app serves all clinics. Each request is routed to the right clinic database:
-> looks it up in the CONTROL database -> tenant "clinic-a"
-> loads clinic-a's config, plan and feature flags
-> opens (or reuses) a connection pool to clinic-a's OWN database
-> the route runs its queries on that pool only
-> response is rendered with clinic-a's branding
